source_basis.guide_paraphrase: The guide recommends reusing twelve labelled lab cases plus the unlabelled kit pool; its designed distribution is nine obvious positive, nine obvious negative and fourteen challenge cases. Two extra obvious cases complete ten per group.

criteria_scope: Preserve each kit case's original single-condition criterion and rubric; the two live cases use the existing combined criterion. This is a deliberate per-case calibration scope, not the common all-three-condition draft.
stratum_caveat: Source-designed challenge membership is separate from student uncertainty. Six new challenge flags remain provisional; no student disputed flag is inferred. Four existing lab disputed flags were documented after earlier lab judge runs; original labels and dates are preserved.
prior_exposure_note: The laboratory cases have previously been judged. This set is not a new independent blind holdout.
producing_prompt_scope: base.v1+D25+D27 applies only to LIVE-C001 and LIVE-C006. Kit producing prompt versions were not supplied and are not invented.
remaining_steps: Student reviews/adopts or corrects the seventeen assistant proposals, including the six provisional challenge flags.
Align the rubric/runner with per-case criteria and verify the final reference groups.
Commit exact final references and evaluator before any new judge calls.
Run five evaluations per case for baseline and versioned correction; recompute the trust statement from those results.
selection_rule: Pre-judge draft selection following official kit design: LB-01..12 and PL-01..16, plus recorded LIVE-C001 and LIVE-C006. Excluded PL-17..20 are retained as source-pool reserves. No replacement judge scores exist.
